h1. rotate_password  -  Ansible Role Reference

{panel:title=At a Glance|borderColor=#0B7A75|titleBGColor=#E6F4F3|borderWidth=2}
*Role:* {{roles/rotate_password}}
*Called by:* {{sys_password_rotation/main.yml}} (with {{target_user: "SYS"}})
*Default target:* {{SYS}}  -  the role is generic and can rotate any Oracle account
*Phases:* 11 sequential phases inside a single {{block/rescue}}
*Failure behaviour:* Failure on one database is captured and recorded; the estate continues
{panel}

----

h2. Objective

Rotates an Oracle user's password on a single ExaCC database node. Designed to be called once per confirmed PRIMARY by the driving playbook. All pre-checks run before any mutation  -  the credential is only changed if all checks pass and {{rotation_required}} evaluates to {{true}}.

The role is *generic*: the connect syntax, Data Guard propagation method, and break-glass file naming all adapt to the configured {{target_user}}.

----

h2. Role Structure

{code}
roles/rotate_password/
+-- tasks/
|   +-- main.yml                     # Entry point  -  block/rescue wrapper
|   +-- precheck_vault.yml           # Phase 1   -  Vault role reachability + age gate
|   +-- detect_topology.yml          # Phase 2   -  dbaascli topology (role, SCAN, PDBs)
|   +-- precheck_oracle.yml          # Phase 3   -  Credential validation, account status
|   +-- precheck_dataguard.yml       # Phase 4   -  DG lag check (conditional)
|   +-- precheck_password_policy.yml # Phase 5   -  PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME profile check
|   +-- precheck_sessions.yml        # Phase 6   -  Active sessions + RMAN gate
|   +-- evaluate_rotation.yml        # Phase 7   -  Age gate + break-glass write
|   +-- rotate.yml                   # Phase 8   -  dbaascli changePassword
|   +-- action_dataguard.yml         # Phase 9   -  Propagation to standbys (conditional)
|   +-- action_commvault.yml         # Phase 10  -  Commvault notification (conditional)
|   `-- post_validate.yml            # Phase 11  -  New cred test + Vault version confirm
+-- defaults/main.yml
+-- vars/main.yml
`-- meta/main.yml
{code}

----

h2. Inputs

h3. Required Hostvars

Supplied by the driving playbook via {{add_host}} in Phase 1. All values are stamped on the inventory host before Phase 2 begins.

|| Variable || Description ||
| {{db_unique_name}} | Oracle {{DB_UNIQUE_NAME}} |
| {{oracle_db_name}} | Oracle {{DB_NAME}}  -  used with {{dbaascli --dbname}} |
| {{node_fqdn}} | FQDN of the cluster node to SSH to |
| {{current_oracle_password}} | Current credential from Vault {{/cred/}} endpoint |
| {{secret_age_days}} | Age of the current Vault secret in days |
| {{vault_role_name}} | Vault role name (e.g. {{SYS_DBPROD01_EXACC}}) |
| {{vault_engine_url}} | Vault base URL |
| {{vault_engine_mount}} | Vault engine mount path |
| {{vault_namespace}} | Vault namespace |
| {{login_token}} | Vault login token  -  used for OTP lookups and all Vault API calls |

h3. Configurable Defaults (defaults/main.yml)

h4. Vault

|| Variable || Default || Description ||
| {{vault_engine_url}} | _(empty)_ | Vault base URL |
| {{vault_engine_mount}} | {{secrets/static-database}} | Engine mount point |
| {{vault_namespace}} | _(empty)_ | Vault {{X-Vault-Namespace}} header |
| {{vault_token_ttl}} | {{6h}} | Login token TTL |

h4. Rotation Policy

|| Variable || Default || Description ||
| {{target_user}} | {{SYS}} | Oracle account to rotate |
| {{password_max_age_days}} | {{90}} | Rotate if credential age exceeds this (days) |
| {{password_min_age_days}} | {{1}} | Skip if rotated more recently than this (days) |
| {{password_length}} | {{20}} | Generated password length |
| {{min_rollover_time_days}} | {{0.0417}} (1 hour) | Minimum {{PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME}} required on the Oracle profile |

h4. Pre-check Thresholds

|| Variable || Default || Description ||
| {{dg_max_lag_seconds}} | {{300}} | Maximum tolerated Data Guard apply lag |
| {{sys_session_warning_threshold}} | {{5}} | Warn (not fail) if active sessions exceed this count |
| {{fail_on_active_rman}} | {{true}} | Abort rotation if an RMAN backup job is running |

h4. Break-Glass

|| Variable || Default || Description ||
| {{breakglass_backup_enabled}} | {{true}} | Write backup of current credential before rotation |
| {{breakglass_backup_path}} | {{/etc/oracle/breakglass}} | Directory for break-glass files (root-owned, mode {{0600}}) |

Break-glass filenames follow the pattern: {{<db_unique_name>_<target_user_lower>_breakglass_<date>.txt}}

h4. Commvault

|| Variable || Default || Description ||
| {{commvault_registry_path}} | {{/etc/CommVaultRegistry}} | Path used to detect Commvault installation |
| {{commvault_process_name}} | {{cvd}} | Process used to confirm Commvault is running |
| {{commvault_ora_user}} | {{sysbackup}} | Oracle account Commvault connects with |
| {{commvault_notify_only}} | {{true}} | Log notification only  -  does not update Commvault credentials automatically |
| {{commvault_notification_log}} | {{/var/log/ansible/commvault_rotation_notice.log}} | Notification log path |

h3. Internal Variables (vars/main.yml)

|| Variable || Description ||
| {{sqlplus_preamble}} | Standard silent sqlplus header ({{WHENEVER SQLERROR}}, {{SET}} commands) |
| {{oracle_env}} | Shell command to source {{/home/oracle/<db_unique_name>.env}}  -  sets {{ORACLE_SID}} and {{ORACLE_HOME}} |
| {{sqlplus_connect}} | {{/ as sysdba}}  -  OS authentication string for account-status queries |

----

h2. Outputs

The role writes its result back to {{localhost}} using {{delegate_to: localhost}} and {{delegate_facts: true}}. The driving playbook's Phase 3 reads these accumulated facts to build the final {{rotation_report}}.

h3. Success (Phase 12)

Appended to {{hostvars['localhost']['rotation_summary']}}:

{code:language=json}
{
  "DBPROD01": {
    "status": "ROTATED",
    "host": "exacc-node1.example.com",
    "vault_role": "SYS_DBPROD01_EXACC",
    "node": "exacc-node1.example.com",
    "db_role": "PRIMARY",
    "dg": true,
    "commvault": false,
    "secret_age": 94.3
  }
}
{code}

{{status}} is {{ROTATED}} if rotation ran, or {{SKIPPED}} if the age gate determined rotation was not yet due.

h3. Failure (rescue block)

Appended to {{hostvars['localhost']['rotation_failures']}}:

{code:language=json}
{
  "DBPROD01": {
    "host": "exacc-node1.example.com",
    "failed_task": "Oracle Pre-check | Validate current SYS credential from Vault",
    "error": "Current SYS password from Vault does not authenticate against Oracle. Vault and Oracle are out of sync."
  }
}
{code}

The host is then re-failed via {{ansible.builtin.fail}} so it registers against {{max_fail_percentage}} in the driving playbook.

----

h2. Phase Detail

|| # || File || Runs when || Description ||
| *1* | {{precheck_vault.yml}} | Always | Assert {{current_oracle_password}}, {{login_token}}, {{vault_role_name}} are present. GET role metadata. Capture {{vault_pre_rotation_version}} baseline. |
| *2* | {{detect_topology.yml}} | Always | {{dbaascli database getDetails --dbname}}. Sets {{db_role}}, {{scan_address}}, {{rac_nodes}}, {{pdb_list}}, {{dg_detected}}, {{commvault_detected}}. |
| *3* | {{precheck_oracle.yml}} | Always | Validate current Vault credential via sqlplus. SYS uses {{CONNECT sys/"$PASS" as sysdba}}; other users use {{CONNECT user/"$PASS"}}. Assert {{db_role == PRIMARY}}. Query account status, expiry, and profile from {{dba_users}}. |
| *4* | {{precheck_dataguard.yml}} | {{dg_detected == true}} | Check DG apply lag <= {{dg_max_lag_seconds}}. Assert no gap sequences. |
| *5* | {{precheck_password_policy.yml}} | Always | Query {{dba_profiles}} for {{account_profile}}. Assert {{PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME}} is set and >= {{min_rollover_time_days}}. Assert no rollover already in progress. |
| *6* | {{precheck_sessions.yml}} | Always | Count active sessions in {{gv$session}}. Warn (not fail) if above {{sys_session_warning_threshold}}. Assert no running RMAN jobs. |
| *7* | {{evaluate_rotation.yml}} | Always | Compare {{secret_age_days}} vs {{password_max_age_days}} to set {{rotation_required}}. If rotating: generate new credential, write break-glass file ({{chmod 0600}}, root-owned). |
| *8* | {{rotate.yml}} | {{rotation_required == true}} | SYS+DG: {{dbaascli changePassword --user SYS --prepareStandbyBlob true}}. Non-SYS or non-DG: standard {{dbaascli changePassword --user <user>}}. Write new credential to Vault {{/role/}} endpoint. |
| *9* | {{action_dataguard.yml}} | {{rotation_required and dg_detected}} | *SYS:* SCP blob to each standby -> {{dbaascli changePassword --standbyBlobFromPrimary}} -> clean up blob. *Non-SYS:* direct {{dbaascli changePassword}} on each standby. Both: POST new credential to Vault for each standby role. |
| *10* | {{action_commvault.yml}} | {{rotation_required and commvault_detected and commvault_ora_user == target_user}} | Append rotation notice to {{commvault_notification_log}}. |
| *11* | {{post_validate.yml}} | {{rotation_required == true}} | Connect sqlplus with new credential. Assert {{CONNECTION_OK}} and account not LOCKED. GET Vault role and assert {{current_version}} incremented. Delete break-glass file. |
| *12* | {{main.yml}} (inline) | Always | {{set_fact rotation_summary}} -> localhost via {{delegate_facts: true}}. |

----

h2. Data Guard Paths

The propagation method in Phase 9 depends on {{target_user}}:

|| Scenario || Phase 8 || Phase 9 ||
| SYS + DG detected | {{dbaascli changePassword --user SYS --prepareStandbyBlob true}} | SCP blob -> each standby -> {{dbaascli changePassword --standbyBlobFromPrimary}} -> delete blob -> update Vault per standby role |
| Non-SYS + DG detected | Standard {{dbaascli changePassword --user <user>}} on primary | Direct {{dbaascli changePassword --user <user>}} on each standby -> update Vault per standby role |
| Any user + no DG | Standard {{dbaascli changePassword --user <user>}} on primary | Phase 9 does not run |

{note:title=Why blobs are SYS-only}
The {{--prepareStandbyBlob}} / {{--standbyBlobFromPrimary}} mechanism is a native ExaCC feature for propagating the SYS password hash through the Data Guard redo transport layer without needing direct DBA connectivity to each standby. It is available for SYS only. For other Oracle accounts in a DG environment, the role connects to each standby directly.
{note}

----

h2. Sequence Diagram

{code:language=mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant PB as Playbook (Phase 2)
    participant Vault as HashiCorp Vault
    participant ExaCC as ExaCC Node
    participant Oracle as Oracle DB (sqlplus)
    participant DG as DG Standby Nodes

    rect rgb(230, 240, 255)
        Note over PB,Vault: Phase 1  -  Vault Pre-check
        PB->>Vault: GET /role/{vault_role_name}
        Vault-->>PB: created_at, current_version (baseline)
        PB->>PB: Assert current_oracle_password present; age >= min_age_days
    end

    rect rgb(230, 255, 230)
        Note over PB,ExaCC: Phase 2  -  Topology Detection
        PB->>ExaCC: dbaascli database getDetails --dbname
        ExaCC-->>PB: dbRole, SCAN, PDB list, topology flags
        PB->>PB: Set db_role, dg_detected, commvault_detected
    end

    rect rgb(255, 245, 230)
        Note over PB,Oracle: Phase 3  -  Oracle Pre-check
        ExaCC->>Oracle: CONNECT {target_user}/"$PASS"[ as sysdba if SYS]
        Oracle-->>ExaCC: CREDENTIAL_OK
        PB->>Oracle: SELECT from dba_users WHERE username = target_user
        Oracle-->>PB: account_status, expiry_date, account_profile
        PB->>PB: Assert db_role == PRIMARY; assert account not LOCKED
    end

    opt dg_detected == true
        rect rgb(255, 230, 230)
            Note over PB,Oracle: Phase 4  -  Data Guard Pre-check
            PB->>Oracle: SELECT lag from v$dataguard_stats
            PB->>PB: Assert lag <= dg_max_lag_seconds; no gap sequences
        end
    end

    rect rgb(245, 230, 255)
        Note over PB,Oracle: Phase 5  -  Password Policy
        PB->>Oracle: SELECT from dba_profiles WHERE profile = account_profile
        Oracle-->>PB: PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME and password limits
        PB->>PB: Assert PASSWORD_ROLLOVER_TIME >= min_rollover_time_days
        PB->>PB: Assert no rollover already in progress
    end

    rect rgb(230, 255, 255)
        Note over PB,Oracle: Phase 6  -  Session and RMAN Gate
        PB->>Oracle: SELECT from gv$session WHERE username = target_user
        Oracle-->>PB: Active session count
        PB->>Oracle: SELECT from v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
        Oracle-->>PB: RMAN job count
        PB->>PB: Warn if sessions > threshold; fail if RMAN running
    end

    rect rgb(255, 255, 220)
        Note over PB,ExaCC: Phase 7  -  Evaluate Rotation
        PB->>PB: secret_age_days >= password_max_age_days -> set rotation_required
        alt rotation_required == true
            PB->>ExaCC: Write break-glass file (chmod 0600, root-owned)
        end
    end

    opt rotation_required == true

        rect rgb(255, 220, 180)
            Note over PB,ExaCC: Phase 8  -  Rotate
            alt dg_detected and target_user == SYS
                PB->>ExaCC: dbaascli changePassword --user SYS --prepareStandbyBlob
            else non-DG or non-SYS
                PB->>ExaCC: dbaascli changePassword --user {target_user}
            end
            PB->>Vault: POST /role/{vault_role_name} with new credential
            Vault-->>PB: 200 OK
        end

        opt dg_detected == true
            rect rgb(220, 220, 255)
                Note over PB,DG: Phase 9  -  Data Guard Propagation
                alt target_user == SYS
                    PB->>ExaCC: SCP blob to each standby
                    loop Each standby
                        PB->>DG: dbaascli changePassword --standbyBlobFromPrimary
                    end
                    PB->>ExaCC: Delete blob (primary + all standbys)
                else non-SYS
                    loop Each standby
                        PB->>DG: dbaascli changePassword --user {target_user}
                    end
                end
                loop Each standby role
                    PB->>Vault: POST /role/{target_user}_{standby}_EXACC
                    Vault-->>PB: 200 OK
                end
            end
        end

        rect rgb(200, 240, 200)
            Note over PB,Vault: Phase 11  -  Post-Validation
            PB->>Oracle: CONNECT {target_user}/"$new_cred"[ as sysdba if SYS]
            Oracle-->>PB: CONNECTION_OK; account_status not LOCKED
            PB->>Vault: GET /role/{vault_role_name}
            Vault-->>PB: current_version > pre-rotation baseline
            PB->>ExaCC: Delete break-glass backup file
        end

    end

    rect rgb(220, 220, 220)
        Note over PB: Phase 12  -  Record Result
        PB->>PB: set_fact rotation_summary -> localhost (ROTATED or SKIPPED)
    end
{code}

{note:title=Mermaid Plugin Required}
The diagram above requires the *Mermaid Diagrams for Confluence* app (Atlassian Marketplace). If the plugin is not installed the diagram will render as a syntax-highlighted code block.
{note}

----

h2. Error Handling

All phases run inside a {{block/rescue}} in {{tasks/main.yml}}. If any phase fails:

# The rescue block captures {{ansible_failed_task.name}} and {{ansible_failed_result.msg}}
# The failure is recorded to {{hostvars['localhost']['rotation_failures']}} via {{delegate_facts: true}}
# The host is explicitly re-failed so it registers against {{max_fail_percentage}} in the driving playbook
# All other databases in the estate continue unaffected (unless {{max_fail_percentage}} is breached)

{warning:title=Break-glass retention on failure}
The break-glass backup file is *only deleted on confirmed success* (Phase 11). If the role fails after Phase 8  -  meaning the credential was changed in Oracle but the Vault write failed  -  the break-glass file intentionally remains on the target host at {{breakglass_backup_path}} for manual recovery. The file contains the old credential and is {{chmod 0600}}, root-owned.
{warning}

----

h2. Connection Model

|| Layer || Account || Method || Credential ||
| SSH login | {{ans_oracle}} | OTP via Vault | {{lookup('_client_.epe.ssh_otp', ansible_host, ...)}} |
| become (admin tasks) | {{root}} | {{ansible.builtin.su}} | OTP via Vault |
| become (sqlplus tasks) | {{oracle}} | {{ansible.builtin.su}} | OTP via Vault |

Oracle OS authentication ({{/ as sysdba}}) is used for account-status, profile, session, and RMAN queries  -  no TNS listener is required for these reads.

Credential validation (Phase 3) and post-rotation connectivity (Phase 11) connect as {{target_user}} directly via sqlplus using the Vault-supplied credential. The per-database environment file ({{/home/oracle/<db_unique_name>.env}}) is sourced before every sqlplus call to set {{ORACLE_SID}} and {{ORACLE_HOME}}.

SSH ControlMaster ({{ControlPersist=60s}}, configured in {{ansible.cfg}}) reduces OTP lookups on clusters with multiple databases  -  one OTP per physical host per play, not one per database.
